marco: Cutting RC candidate for services-api @releng - sha=efb7c9d. Creating RC now. Change-window: 2026-03-22 02:00-04:00 UTC. Requesting QA + sherpa for canary.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC created: rc/efb7c9d-20260321 (id: 4852). Artifacts pinned: service-api:efb7c9d. To promote: `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env canary --kv-warm`

amy: QA: smoke pass on staging, minor logging diff: noticed "auth timeout" spike in trace-2.

jalex: @amy can you paste logs? also tagging @sheriff-ops for rollback readiness.

amy: sure
```text
2026-03-21T18:12:34Z ERROR auth timeout user=1234 trace=abc
2026-03-21T18:12:35Z INFO retrying
```

sheriff-ops: I'll be on call for the promo window. Pre-approved rollback plan: revert to pinned tag service-api:ea9c1b (last known good). Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=ea9c1b -n prod`

marco: thanks. releng please verify release notes include DB migration note and traffic-shim toggle.

releng: done. Release notes: "Service API: add prefix caching and migration v3.2 -> v3.3; watch KV warm; no schema change." (link: https://redwood.internal/release/4852)

marco: starting canary promote now. `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env canary --percent 5`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion started: rc/4852 -> canary (5%). waiter: kv-warm 60s. Logs: warming KV...

marco: kv warm complete. Observability: keep eye on 95th latency and error rate.

amy: canary smoke: ok for text gen paths, error rate trending 0.3% -> 0.5% (small bump)

jalex: ok hold for 10m. If errors >1% for 5min we abort.

marco: moving to prod ramp: `/deploy promote rc/4852 --env prod --stages 10,50,100 --wait-metrics`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting prod ramp: stage 10% -> in progress. Notifying oncall. ETA ~12m

sheriff-ops: seeing a small uptick in 500s from model inference service at 50% payload. threshold tripped at 12:03 UTC. Suggest halt and rollback if continues 3min.

marco: halting at 10% pause. `/deploy abort-stage rc/4852 --reason "inference 5xx uptick"`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Ramp paused at 10%. Reason: metric(inference_5xx) breached threshold. Rollback or debug?

jalex: let's hold; switching traffic back to canary variant, running quick trace grep and heap check.

amy: running canary -> gen logs: `OOM killer` not seen; but JVM GC spikes at same time. Posting heapdump link: s3://ci-artifacts/heapdump-4852.gz

marco: decision call: given it's GC-related under higher load, prefer rollback to last pinned for prod. @sheriff-ops execute rollback when ready.

sheriff-ops: initiating rollback. Command: `kubectl set image deploy/service-api service-api=ea9c1b -n prod && /deploy resume --target rc/4852 --action rollback`

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback initiated. Prod traffic routed back to service-api:ea9c1b. Monitor: latency/500s returning to baseline.

marco: confirm rollback success?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollback complete: prod now running service-api:ea9c1b. All checks green.

amy: QA smoke on prod shows errors back to 0.1% and latency normal.

marco: logging postmortem note: "RC 4852 failed prod ramp due to inference GC spike. Action: revert, open perf ticket, re-run RC with tuned heap flags and microbatches." Assign to @jalex.

jalex: ack. will schedule a re-cut when patch ready. ETA next week.

marco: thanks everyone. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
